notes.title: Welcome to Abyssal Acres!
notes.content: [p]The game has its own page on Steam now![/p][p]Thank you for your interest in the game and for adding it to your wishlists.[/p][p][/p][p]I am actively working on the game. The following things have been added recently:[/p][list][*][p]Game speed adjustment (x1-x2-x3)[/p][/*][*][p]Pause feature[/p][/*][*][p]Logic for barracks building operation and creation of demon warriors[/p][/*][*][p]Combat part of the game has been started. 4 classes of warriors have been selected. The logic for attack and damage is being developed.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681020/e05da2b106314dd0f259c45abdd35800f72c74b5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I'm posting news and videos of current development progress in my [url="https://t.me/novaxpressed" style="button"]telegram-channel[/url] . You're welcome![/p]
